ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( LOWER(Component_Classname__c) == 'component.c.expstatusbarmessage' && (sObject_Field_1__c == null || sObject_Field_2__c == null || sObject_Field_3__c == null || sObject__c == null || ( LOWER(sObject__c) != 'contact' && LOWER(sObject__c) != 'client_household__c' && LOWER(sObject__c) != 'case_record__c')), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Message component requires values for sObject, sObject Field 1 (Summary), sObject Field 2 (Severity), and sObject Field 3 (Strength). sObject Field 4 (Detail) is optional. sObject must be equal to Contact, Case_Record__c or Client_Household__c.
